source_commit_binding.scope: v3 recovery policy, opt-in diagnostics and native regression tests

phase_build_receipt.source_commit_note: Frozen PRa306 source plus explicit overlay files; the compiled native files were committed unchanged after the build. Original build receipt is retained.

classified_terminal_events.timestamp_basis: date inferred from trial and WLog clock in UTC Docker environment

udp_tunnel.qualification: Initial readiness and recorded failure are separate; absence of a failure log does not prove uninterrupted UDP activity.

summary.scope: Low-frequency central-content pixel changes only; not client FPS, input/display latency, decrypted payload integrity or application goodput. Observer health and native session/tunnel health are separate.
summary.qualification: Pixel hashes are canonical RGB; unused bits/padding are excluded. Substantial change is a conservative content diagnostic, not an automatic native pass.

process_receipt.scope: 1 Hz sampled visual progress, not FPS/input latency/goodput

actual_phase_progress.qualification: Only captures wholly inside actual native phase; comparisons require the previous admitted capture, excluding post-exit/cleanup frames.

visual_progress.qualification: Central-region pixel samples, not physical FPS, latency, full-stream integrity or automatic native success.

sampled_stalls.qualification: Consecutive linked1Hz pixel samples. Identical sampled frames do not prove no activity between captures; this is not physical FPS or input latency.

visual_progress.attention_qualification: Ten seconds or zero changed comparisons flags a surviving sampled visual stall for inspection, not an automatic transport failure.

healthy_visual_prefix.qualification: Only captures wholly inside actual native phase; comparisons require the previous admitted capture, excluding post-exit/cleanup frames.
